requirement_text.ISS-0332: Backfill routine for DEFINITION_PROMOTED schema_version 2 for pre-existing tenants. New module Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Backfill and Mix task mix letflow.backfill_event_type_versions.

task.description:
Security review of the two new files on feature/WF03-ISS0332-20260826:
- lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex
- lib/mix/tasks/letflow.backfill_event_type_versions.ex

Check out the feature branch before reading the files. Gate against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md INV-1 through INV-8. Key concerns for this specific change:
- INV-1 (tenant data isolation): does Backfill.run/1 correctly scope each register_type/2 call to a single tenant's schema? It should be passing tenant_id from each Registration row.
- INV-3 (no raw SQL / injection): no raw SQL in the new code (it delegates to register_type/2 which owns the SQL).
- INV-4 (no credentials in logs): the Logger.warning for :tenant_not_provisioned only logs tenant_id (a UUID), not any credential or secret.
- INV-7 (identifier injection): verify there is no identifier interpolation in the new code.
- The Mix task hardcodes the DEFINITION_PROMOTED v2 json_schema literal -- verify it matches exactly what's in @platform_event_type_seed_attrs in lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex (no schema drift).
acceptance_criteria: All INV-1 through INV-8 checked against both new files
Tenant isolation confirmed: each register_type/2 call uses the correct tenant_id from its own Registration row
No SQL injection risk in new code
Mix task json_schema literal matches lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex @platform_event_type_seed_attrs DEFINITION_PROMOTED v2 exactly
